lines.text: He saws a bucket clean in half and tries to make it hold water with a can of spray.
Flex Seal is the only one of three that actually holds the water.
Because it sprays on so thick that it bridges the gap like a rubber skin instead of just coating the edges.
beats: ai:thick black rubber coating stretching across a crack in white plastic macro

lines.text: But on a cracked pipe underwater Rust-Oleum holds all the way to 43 psi which is about the water pressure in a house.
And Flex Seal scrapes right off the smooth PVC because it barely bonds to slick plastic.
beats: ai:a rubber coating peeling off smooth white plastic pipe macro

lines.text: On a metal tank Flex Seal starts leaking at just 2 psi.
That's less pressure than you blow into a balloon so it fills gaps well but it doesn't stick to everything.
beats: ai:a person blowing up a red balloon

lines.text: In the end Flex Seal and Rust-Oleum tie with two wins each so the TV hype is only half true.
Would you trust it on your roof?
